entries.title: PS5SX2 (PlayStation 2)
entries.description:
PS5SX2 2.10 — PlayStation 2 emulator (PCSX2).

MANUAL INSTALL — ZIP contains TWO folders:
1. PPSA99203/ → /data/homebrew/PPSA99203/
2. PCSX2/ → /data/PCSX2/ (keep existing saves)

BEFORE YOU PLAY
• Load kstuff → ShadowMount+ → ONE PS5SX2 helper ELF.
• Put your own PS2 BIOS in /data/PCSX2/bios/.
• Put game backups in /data/PCSX2/games/.

IF IT WON'T START
• CE-107750-0? Check folder and eboot.bin permissions (755).
• Remove PS2 discs before shutting down.

entries.title: PS5SX3 (PlayStation 3)
entries.description:
PS5SX3 v7.1 — experimental PlayStation 3 emulator (RPCS3).

INSTALL — .7z archive:
1. PPSA99303/ → /data/homebrew/PPSA99303/
2. Check eboot.bin and sce_sys/ are directly inside.

BEFORE YOU PLAY
• Load jailbreak/kstuff → ShadowMount+ → PS5SXHelper-no-data-mount.elf.
• ShadowMount+ must provide /data; this helper does not mount it.
• PS3 firmware: get PS3UPDAT.PUP from Sony; never use PS5 system update.

IF IT WON'T START
• CE-107750-0? Set title folder and eboot.bin permissions to 755.
• Check there is no extra nested PPSA99303/ folder.

NOTE: v7.1 release mentions a PS3 update file; redistribution rights unverified. Title ID PPSA99303 may be shared with other homebrew.

entries.title: PICO-8 PS5
entries.description:
PICO-8 PS5 v0.1.2 — fantasy-console launcher.

INSTALL
1. PPSA99808/ → /data/homebrew/PPSA99808/
2. Copy licensed Linux PICO-8 files to PPSA99808/pico8/:
   pico8_dyn AND pico8.dat (both required).

BEFORE YOU PLAY
• Load kstuff + ShadowMountPlus + elfldr (:9021).
• Launch PICO-8 from the PS5 home screen.

IF IT WON'T START
• Check both PICO-8 files and matching version.
• Log: /data/pico8/loader.log
• Licensed PICO-8 files are NOT in the catalog ZIP.

entries.title: Ruffle Flash PS5
entries.description:
Ruffle Flash PS5 v1.2.0 — SWF / Flash emulator.

INSTALL
1. PPSA68091/ → /data/homebrew/PPSA68091/
2. Load kstuff + ShadowMountPlus + Ruffle Helper ELF.

BEFORE YOU PLAY
• Put .swf games in /data/ruffle/games/.
• Keep each game's extra files in its own folder.
• Start Ruffle Flash from the PS5 home screen.

IF IT WON'T START
• Check Ruffle's matching helper is loaded.
• Check title folder/eboot.bin and ShadowMount+.
• Log: /data/ruffle/ruffle.log
